translations.web: Therefore since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
translations.bsb: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
translations.kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
translations.asv: Seeing that these things are thus all to be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy living and godliness,
